release_notes:
What's New in v1.1.9

- Audio & Microphone Fix: Host mic voice transmission fully resolved; local audio streams and speakerphone un-muted and boosted upon joining channel so all participants hear clearly.
- Text Encoding & Clean UI: Completely eliminated garbled mojibake characters across call screen and dialogs, replacing them with crisp native icons and clean typography.
- Incoming Call Delivery Fix: Converted call notifications to high-priority data payloads, guaranteeing recipient phones ring instantly even when locked or in the background.
- Full Camera Layout: No more half-face cutoffs; calls now use full camera fit mode, plus WhatsApp-style 1-on-1 video calling with floating local preview.
